title: Open Values Passport v0.1
description: A small file that says how much each of ten shared values matters to one person, from 0 to 5, with no name in it. The person keeps it and can carry it to any app that reads the format.

format.description: Always "open-values-passport". Tells a reader that this file is a values file.

version.description: The version of the passport format this file follows, 0.1. Readers of 0.1 ignore fields they do not know.

source.description: Which app wrote the file, such as "conscious-consuming", or the group's name when the file was made by adding up several people's files. Not a person's name.

exported.description: When the file was downloaded, as an ISO 8601 date and time. Conscious Consuming sets it; other apps may leave it out.

planet.description: Weight for the environment: sustainability and how long things last. 0 to 5.

people.description: Weight for fairness to other people: ethics and how workers and others are treated. 0 to 5.

openness.description: Weight for openness: transparency, open and free things, independence, and being able to leave. 0 to 5.

access.description: Weight for access: low cost, accessible, and easy to start. 0 to 5.

wellbeing.description: Weight for wellbeing: health, safety and calm. 0 to 5.

autonomy.description: Weight for autonomy: privacy, control and ownership. 0 to 5.

animals.description: Weight for the welfare of animals. 0 to 5.

community.description: Weight for community: local, independent and co-operative options. 0 to 5.

quality.description: Weight for quality: rigour, craft, depth and accuracy. 0 to 5.

joy.description: Weight for joy: engagement, delight and beauty. 0 to 5.

values.description: How much the person cares about each shared value, from 0 (ignore it) to 5 (matters most). 3 is neutral. A value that is missing was not set, which is not the same as 0.
